name: Groovebox 12 Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Kits for Groovebox 12 in the most common styles: techno, house, trance, drum & bass, dubstep, hip-hop, funk & disco, electro, pop, rock, jazz and synthwave. Each kit sets the tempo, the drum sounds, a one-bar groove and a bass line, with pads and leads where the style calls for them.
